{{Top|ca|leg}}
The '''Cortez banking clan''' was an organization which,<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Trust Issues}}</ref> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Trust Issues" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> was pushing for controversial new regulations that would render loan schemes in the criminal underworld obsolete. Consequently, several crime syndicates were looking for neutral representatives to protect their interests.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to represent the syndicates. Using the syndicates' viscous reputations, their companion convinced the Cortez banking clan to abandon their regulation plans.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Cortez banking clan was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Crew Skill Mission "Trust Issues," though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
